system.notes:
Abyssal beast from the time before demons. Hideous mash-up of an ogre's head atop a thorax with eight jutting spider legs, each with bat-like webbing. Thirty foot wingspan and weighs 3 tons.

AC 13, HP 49, ATK 3 claw +8 (2d6 + stinking curse), MV double near (climb, fly), S +4, D -1, C +4, I -2, W +1, Ch +1, AL C, LV 10

Great Evil. Only damaged by cold iron or magical sources.

Horrific Appearance. Mortal creatures looking directly at qlippoth, CON 15+ or 1d4 CHA damage. On success, immune for 24 hours.

Stinking Curse. CON 15+ or 1d4 CHA damage (can't heal while ill). Repeat check each day; ends on success. Die and rise as ghast at 0 CHA.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
